en: Only your nickname and introduction are editable here. Existing photos, contact QR image and route preferences are preserved.
zh-Hans: 此处仅编辑昵称与简介。现有照片、联系二维码和路线偏好将保留。

en: Save these profile details to your account? Other existing profile fields will be preserved.
zh-Hans: 将这些资料保存到你的账号？其他现有资料将保留。

en: Sign in to edit your profile.
Your profile was saved and verified.
The save result is not confirmed. Saving is locked to prevent a duplicate update. Check the result again; no update will be resent.
zh-Hans: 保存结果尚未确认。为避免重复更新，已锁定保存。请再次查询结果，不会重新提交更新。

en: Could not safely load the complete profile. Reload before saving.
zh-Hans: 无法安全读取完整资料。保存前请重新加载。

en: Your profile changed on the server. Review the refreshed details and edit again.
zh-Hans: 服务器上的资料已变化。请查看刷新后的资料并重新编辑。

en: Your changes were rejected. Review the message and edit before trying again.
zh-Hans: 更改被拒绝。请根据提示编辑后再试。

en: The update was not sent. Review your changes again.
zh-Hans: 更新尚未发送。请重新确认更改。

en: The current profile matches your changes, but the original save request was not acknowledged and may still be running. Saving remains locked; checking again will not resend it.
zh-Hans: 当前资料与你的更改一致，但原保存请求尚未收到确认，可能仍在处理中。保存仍被锁定；再次查询不会重新提交。
